mapper.select: SELECT * FROM spectra_core.scheduler_control_command WHERE status = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY requested_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM spectra_core.scheduler_control_command WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spectra_core.scheduler_control_command ( id, job_id, target_runtime_id, target_session_key, expected_runtime_version, command_type, status, idempotency_key, reason, requested_by, requested_at, deadline_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted, version ) VALUES ( #{command.id}, #{command.jobId}, #{command.targetRuntimeId}, #{command.targetSessionKey}, #{command.expectedRuntimeVersion}, #{command.commandType}, #{command.status}, #{command.idempotencyKey}, #{command.reason}, #{command.requestedBy}, #{command.requestedAt}, #{command.deadlineAt}, #{command.createdBy}, #{command.createdAt}, #{command.updatedBy}, #{command.updatedAt}, #{command.deleted}, #{command.version} ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_control_command SET status = 'APPLYING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'REQUESTED'

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_control_command SET status = 'APPLIED', applied_at = #{appliedAt}, finished_at = #{appliedAt}, result_code = #{resultCode}, result_message = #{resultMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'APPLYING'

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_control_command SET status = #{status}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, result_code = #{resultCode}, result_message = #{resultMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'APPLYING'
